scope: Tile material selection in STUDIO ONE and RANDAL Général
notes: Selection only: all original catalogue definitions remain available for saved-project restoration.
31 representative materials were downloaded and visually reviewed; every colour/face was not downloaded.
Azuli Mood delivered faces were 47–56 pixels despite source metadata claiming 1200×700.
Domus narrow 4.8×45 cm native faces remain: a delivered 569×58 face is proportionate to this narrow physical tile.
Physical gloss, colour measurement and texture pixel density are not independently certified.
Floral/botanical panels are excluded to follow the repository visual instruction; they are not labelled blurry.
